working_title: Project Dependence and Label Provenance in Smart Contract Vulnerability Evaluation
research_questions: Project and clone dependence with a common test and matched training size
Frozen methods on independent labelled data
Ranking versus review workload and tool coverage

historical.dappscan_zero_semantics: no published finding; not confirmed absence

fixed_test.training_size_rule: minimum feasible common size per class and test; report infeasible rather than splitting dependency components
fixed_test.learning_curve_fractions: fix after data feasibility and before model comparison
fixed_test.joint_disjoint_rule: safe_group(train) intersection safe_group(T) must be empty; compute the full transitive project-union-clone graph on the frozen source population before cohort restriction.

regime_specific_rules.other_files_unrestricted: exclude exact test object IDs only
regime_specific_rules.project_disjoint: exclude all declared projects represented in T
regime_specific_rules.clone_disjoint: exclude all clone components represented in T
regime_specific_rules.joint_project_clone_disjoint: exclude every full transitive joint component intersecting T

training.hyperparameters: existing fixed settings or inner group-aware training-only tuning

metrics.ties: expected precision/recall and feasible range under label-independent within-score-tie permutation; freeze exact implementation before scoring

statistics.few_clusters: report individual groups and restrict inference; bootstrap is not a remedy

human_label_review.sampling: Record inclusion criteria and selection probabilities; use design weights for population estimates under unequal-probability sampling, otherwise restrict conclusions to the audited cases.

freeze_prerequisites: training and test manifests and hashes
fixed model configurations and tuning budget
